ModMetaData.name: Glue Rimworld
ModMetaData.author: glue
ModMetaData.description: Glue Rimworld is a foothold integration that drives real pawn behavior selection through GLUE's existing declarative actor engine (actor/status/status-tick -> derive-deficits -> behavior/arbiter -> apply-effects). Each colonist's real Need values (Food/Rest/Joy/Comfort/Beauty/Outdoors) and real TimeAssignmentDef schedule slot are mirrored out to a locally-running glue-runtime-host process over loopback HTTP (POST /api/execute), which renders the same actor/behavior candidate chain already proven end-to-end by the Zomboid "one actor's day" lane (Z-1), using colony/pawn-need-taxonomy, colony/pawn-schedule-templates, and colony/pawn-work-priorities seed data that originated as RimWorld's own NeedDef/TimeAssignmentDef/WorkTypeDef vocabulary. This is a foothold, not a full behavior replacement: it observes and logs the engine's selected behavior candidate per pawn per in-game hour rather than overriding RimWorld's own job-giver stack outright. See NEXT_STEPS.md for what a full build-out still needs.
